android.changelog: YouTube and YouTube Music: when YouTube asks to confirm you're not a bot, iDownloader tries other ways in and offers a one-time sign-in. Better TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube Music support, plus every site yt-dlp knows. New icon.
